Bikes and Coffee (Bike Long Beach)

Long Beach, CA

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Bikes and Coffee (Bike Long Beach) is a social group ride in Long Beach, CA. It meets last Sunday of the month, meet 9:30 am, roll 10:00 am, starting at Varies (usually Gaucho Beach, SteelCraft, or the end of the beach path at Ocean & Bayshore). Expect about 8–12 miles, slow, casual.

About the Bikes and Coffee (Bike Long Beach) group ride

A monthly slow ride on bike paths and quiet streets to a different coffee spot each time. Meant for people new to cycling; any bike works. Led by volunteers from the local advocacy group. No one gets left behind.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
